mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS drops > 100k in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it signals a tightening cycle with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 3 months, but 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2.5% YoY, it signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 > 2.5% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 > 2.5% YoY, but 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM, coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in the same month, signals a contractionary supply shock with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO drops > 1% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 1% MoM and UNRATE rises > 0.3% MoM, but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
